findings.back_translation: No download change for {{minutes}} minutes — the installation was stopped

findings.suggested: Inga nedladdningsframsteg på {{minutes}} minuter — installationen stoppades

findings.en: SteamGridDB artwork search is unavailable on this build.
findings.tr: Sökning efter SteamGridDB-artwork är inte tillgänglig i denna build.
findings.back_translation: Search for SteamGridDB artwork is not available in this build.
findings.issue: Leaves 'artwork' and 'build' in English, while sibling SteamGridDB rows use 'konstverk' and 'version'. Inconsistent terminology.
findings.suggested: Sökning efter SteamGridDB-bilder är inte tillgänglig i denna version.

findings.en: This reveals the key — removing it from Giftable spares for good — and redeems it on your Steam account. There's no undo.
findings.tr: Detta avslöjar nyckeln — vilket tar bort den från Giftable spares permanent — och löser in den på ditt Steam-konto. Det går inte att ångra.
findings.back_translation: This reveals the key — which removes it from Giftable spares permanently — and redeems it on your Steam account. It cannot be undone.
findings.issue: The section name 'Giftable spares' stays in English here, but other rows (c2Action, c2Body, revealConfirmBody) translate it as 'Kan ges bort'. In this confirmation for an action that can't be undone, the dialog names a section that doesn't appear under that name in the Swedish UI.
findings.suggested: Detta visar nyckeln — vilket tar bort den från ”Kan ges bort” permanent — och löser in den på ditt Steam-konto. Det går inte att ångra.

findings.en: This key is safe in Giftable spares — revealing it here would throw away the ability to gift it. Take it to Giftable spares instead.
findings.tr: Den här nyckeln är säker i Kan ges bort — om du visar den här försvinner möjligheten att ge bort den. Gå till Kan ges bort istället.
findings.back_translation: This key is safe in Can-be-given-away — if you show it here the ability to give it away disappears. Go to Can-be-given-away instead.
findings.issue: The meaning is right, but using the section name 'Kan ges bort' unquoted inside a sentence reads as broken grammar ('är säker i Kan ges bort'). Put it in quotes, or choose a noun-style label.
findings.suggested: Den här nyckeln är säker i ”Kan ges bort” — om du visar den här går det inte längre att ge bort den. Gå till ”Kan ges bort” i stället.

findings.en: Claim this key
findings.tr: Gör anspråk på denna nyckel
findings.back_translation: Lay claim to this key
findings.issue: 'Göra anspråk på' is a legalistic, literal rendering of 'claim'. It also doesn't match syncToEnableClaiming, which uses 'inlösen' for the same concept.
findings.suggested: Hämta ut denna nyckel

findings.en: Temporarily unavailable — retry in {{minutes}}m
findings.tr: Tillfälligt otillgänglig — försök igen om {{minutes}}m
findings.back_translation: Temporarily unavailable — try again in {{minutes}}m
findings.issue: The 'm' abbreviation reads as metres in Swedish. The minute abbreviation is 'min'.
findings.suggested: Tillfälligt otillgänglig — försök igen om {{minutes}} min

findings.en: Expires {{date}}
findings.tr: Upphör {{date}}
findings.back_translation: Ceases {{date}}
findings.issue: 'Upphör' needs a complement ('upphör att gälla'). On its own it reads as truncated. 'Går ut' is the idiomatic phrasing for a key expiring.
findings.suggested: Går ut {{date}}

findings.en: No pick deadline available

findings.back_translation: No choice-deadline available

findings.en: No expiration

findings.back_translation: No expiry date

findings.en: Revealing shows the actual key and removes it from Giftable spares for good. If you don't own this game yet, make sure that's really true before continuing — there's no undo.

findings.back_translation: To show it reveals the actual key and removes it from Can-be-given-away for good. ...
findings.issue: The opening 'Att visa den avslöjar...' is clumsy and circular (show/reveal). The rest is accurate. The section name also needs quoting, as in c2Body.
findings.suggested: Om du visar nyckeln tas den bort från ”Kan ges bort” för gott. Om du inte redan äger spelet, se till att det verkligen stämmer innan du fortsätter — det går inte att ångra.

terminology_notes: Mostly consistent. Install = installera/installation, Library = bibliotek, Store = butik, Sign in = logga in, Redeem = lösa in, Reveal = visa, Sync = synka, Retry = Försök igen, build = version (except edit-game.sgdb.unavailable). Brands are kept and inflected correctly (Steams, Humbles, GameLibs, Steam-bibliotek, CrossOver-bottle). Inconsistencies: 'Giftable spares' is English in one row and 'Kan ges bort' elsewhere; bottle = 'flaska' in one row and 'bottle' in five; SteamGridDB artwork = 'artwork' in one row and 'konstverk' in two; Claim = 'göra anspråk' vs 'inlösen'; Synka vs Synkronisera. Ellipsis spacing varies ('installationsalternativ …', 'Installera med alternativ …', 'Ta bort alla kopior …' vs 'Laddar…'). Swedish typography allows either, so this is not counted as a finding. A → Ö / Ö → A sort labels are a good localisation.
overall: The translation is good. There are no critical errors, all {{placeholders}} are preserved exactly, and meaning is accurate throughout. The one major issue is the untranslated 'Giftable spares' section name in a Humble key confirmation that can't be undone, where other rows call it 'Kan ges bort'. Everything else is minor: a gender slip (Ingen utgångsdatum), the 'overlägg' misspelling repeated across the EOS rows, singular 'Installerad' as a view label, literal 'konstverk'/'flaska', and some awkward phrasing. Confidence is high on grammar and meaning. It is moderate on 'overlägg' vs 'överlägg' as the preferred term, and on whether 'bottle' should be localised at all. Without the live UI I can't confirm how the section-name labels actually render.
